confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Ocho Rios and Jamaican tourism pricing, with no live booking pages or current listings checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are the more reliable; cocktail and wine are inferred from the local beer relationship and are less certain. Accommodation anchors are the least certain because guesthouse and hostel supply in Ocho Rios is thin and rates vary a lot by season and property. July 2026 falls in the low season and hurricane season, which may push some accommodation rates below peak-season levels. USD is widely quoted in tourist venues, but local prices are often set in JMD, so USD equivalents carry exchange-rate uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on the Caribbean resort-town pattern of Ocho Rios, using comparable north-coast Jamaican tourism towns such as Montego Bay and Negril, and mid-sized Caribbean and Latin American tourism destinations. Region is set to Latin America because Jamaica is grouped with Latin America and the Caribbean in standard regional classifications, although it is geographically in the Caribbean.
